title: Juggernaut of Justice
front_description: Republic and Separatist forces clash head-on as the great conflict exploding across the surface of the planet Geonosis continues. An astonishing array of fanciful war machines and vehicles are rolled out by the fighting factions. They fire laserblasts at each her with reckless abandon, causing the ground itself to shake. But even a barrage of separatist missiles cannot prevent the Republic war machines from their inexorable advance.
back_description: Concept design of the Intergalactic Banking Clan droid by Ryan Church.
